standard_hachimi_comparison.impact: Runtime createEmptyCache() MUST parameterize head dimension per model descriptor (64 for standard, 72 for QT) to avoid tensor shape mismatch in ONNX Runtime.

no_repeat_ngram_size.impact: QT model card explicitly warns against no-repeat n-gram. Runtime MUST set noRepeatNgramSize = 0 for QT to avoid destroying natural Sino-Vietnamese word repetition.
